headline: Advance Cave Tour Reservations Required
reservation: Cave tours frequently sell out weeks in advance, especially during spring break and summer. Reservations are for specific timed entries and do not include lodging; confirm tour status and time zone on the official NPS site.

days.title: Subterranean Discovery

stops.name: Mammoth Cave Visitor Center
stops.detail: Check in for your reserved tour and explore geological exhibits explaining the world's longest cave system.

stops.name: Historic Tour Route
stops.detail: Walk through massive passages and learn about early cave exploration and the saltpeter mining history.

days.driving: Allow 20–30 minutes; park roads are winding and subject to local speed limits
days.note: Note the Central Time Zone boundary; Louisville (SDF) operates on Eastern Time.

days.title: Green River and Forest Vistas

stops.name: Heritage Trail
stops.detail: Experience an accessible boardwalk stroll through the hardwood forest near the Old Guide's Cemetery.

stops.name: Green River Bluffs Overlook
stops.detail: View the winding Green River from a high vantage point to see the landscape that carved the caves below.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes; verify Green River Ferry status if crossing the river
days.note: Spring and Fall offer the best foliage, but wet leaves can make forest trails slippery.

days.title: Deep Formations and Surface Wildlife

stops.name: Dripstone Trail
stops.detail: Book this specific route to see stalactites, stalagmites, and the Frozen Niagara flowstone formation.

stops.name: Sloan’s Crossing Pond
stops.detail: Walk the boardwalk to spot turtles and migratory birds in a quiet wetland environment.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes; distances between surface trailheads are deceptive
days.note: Cave temperatures remain a constant 54°F; a light jacket is necessary regardless of surface heat.

intel.title: Visitor Center Congestion
intel.text: The main lot near the Visitor Center serves most tour departures and fills by mid-day. Arrive at least 30 minutes before your scheduled tour to secure a space.

intel.title: Karst Topography Deadzones
intel.text: Cellular reception is extremely limited throughout the park's wooded interior and non-existent underground. Confirm all reservation details before entering the park gates.

intel.title: Gateway Service Stations
intel.text: No fuel is sold within the park boundaries. Fill your tank in Cave City or Park City before heading to the Visitor Center area.

intel.title: Time Zone Awareness
intel.text: The park operates on Central Time, while the nearest major airport in Louisville is on Eastern Time. Always set your watch to Central Time to avoid missing tour departures.

intel.title: River Crossing Status
intel.text: The Green River Ferry is the primary way to access the north side of the park but closes during high water. Check the park's Twitter or official site for daily status.

plan.arrival: Fly into SDF and drive south for roughly 90 minutes; check into your base in Cave City or Park City before your first tour.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are fine for paved park roads. RVs should check length restrictions for the Green River Ferry and specific campground sites.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset from the Green River Bluffs Overlook provides dramatic shadows over the river valley during the autumn months.
